title: Top 10 Essential Verbs, Part 2 (CEFR A0–A1) in Tatar
dek: Part 2 of high-frequency verb curriculum in Tatar: do/make, speak/tell, look/see, listen/hear, must, take/give/get, live, wait, understand, ask/answer.

blocks.text: Welcome to our CEFR A0–A1 master guide for high-frequency verbs in Tatar! Frequency studies show that mastering these 10 core verbs unlocks over 80% of everyday communication.

items: **1. To Do / To Make (Tatar)** (forms): Actions and creation. *Example:* "Actions and creation in Tatar." — *Collocations:* *do homework*, *make coffee*, *do best*.
**2. To Speak / Talk / Say / Tell (Tatar)** (forms): Speech and message. *Example:* "Communication in Tatar." — *Collocations:* *speak language*, *say yes*, *tell story*.
**3. To Look / Watch / See (Tatar)** (forms): Visual perception. *Example:* "Vision in Tatar." — *Collocations:* *look at*, *watch TV*, *see you*.
**4. To Listen / To Hear (Tatar)** (forms): Auditory perception. *Example:* "Hearing in Tatar." — *Collocations:* *listen to*, *hear sound*, *listen well*.
**5. To Must / To Have To (Tatar)** (forms): Obligation and necessity. *Example:* "Obligation in Tatar." — *Collocations:* *must go*, *have to study*, *must do*.
**6. To Take / Give / Get (Tatar)** (forms): Transfer and receipt. *Example:* "Transfer in Tatar." — *Collocations:* *take time*, *give help*, *get home*.
**7. To Live (Tatar)** (forms): Residence and lifestyle. *Example:* "Residence in Tatar." — *Collocations:* *live in*, *live together*, *where live*.
**8. To Wait (Tatar)** (forms): Waiting and expectation. *Example:* "Waiting in Tatar." — *Collocations:* *wait for*, *wait minute*, *can't wait*.
**9. To Understand (Tatar)** (forms): Understanding. *Example:* "Comprehension in Tatar." — *Collocations:* *understand well*, *I understand*, *get it*.
**10. To Ask / To Answer (Tatar)** (forms): Inquiring and answering. *Example:* "Questions and answers in Tatar." — *Collocations:* *ask question*, *answer phone*, *ask why*.
